title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 901–950 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Does anyone know the opening hours of the museum?
examples.zh: 有人知道這家博物館的開放時間嗎？

examples.en: Is anyone interested in joining the weekend hiking trip to Yangmingshan?
examples.zh: 有人有興趣參加週末去陽明山的健行活動嗎？

examples.en: If anyone calls for me, please tell them I will return after three.
examples.zh: 如果有人打電話找我，請轉告他們我三點後會回來。

examples.en: Someone left their umbrella at the classroom door.
examples.zh: 有人把雨傘遺忘在教室門口了。

examples.en: There is someone waiting for you at the front reception desk.
examples.zh: 在前台接待處有人正在等候你。

examples.en: It feels comforting when someone genuinely listens to your worries.
examples.zh: 當有人真誠傾聽你的煩惱時，感覺十分令人寬慰。

examples.en: Good morning, everyone! Let's begin our English lesson.
examples.zh: 大家早安！我們開始上英文課吧。

examples.en: Everyone deserves equal opportunities to learn and achieve their goals.
examples.zh: 每個人都應享有平等學習與實現目標的機會。

examples.en: In Taiwan, almost everyone is familiar with the taste of bubble tea.
examples.zh: 在台灣，幾乎每個人都熟悉珍珠奶茶的滋味。

examples.en: No one likes getting stuck in a traffic jam.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡塞在車陣之中。

examples.en: The classroom was completely silent because no one spoke during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間沒有人說話，因此教室裡一片寂靜。

examples.en: No one can predict what surprising technological advances will arrive next.
examples.zh: 沒有人能夠預料接下來會出現什麼令人驚喜的科技突破。

examples.en: Would you like anything to drink with your lunch?
examples.zh: 你的午餐想搭配任何飲品嗎？

examples.en: If you need anything during your stay, please contact room service.
examples.zh: 住宿期間如果你需要任何東西，請隨時聯繫客房服務。

examples.en: She was so exhausted that she couldn't eat anything for dinner.
examples.zh: 她太疲累了，以至於晚餐什麼東西都吃不下。

examples.en: There is something delicious cooking in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡正在煮著某種很香的美味料理。

examples.en: I have something important to discuss with our project manager.
examples.zh: 我有一件重要的事情想與我們的專案經理討論。

examples.en: Try something new every day to keep your mind active and curious.
examples.zh: 每天嘗試一點新事物，讓心智保持活躍與充滿好奇。

examples.en: Everything is ready for the school sports day tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天學校運動會的一切都準備就緒了。

examples.en: Money cannot buy everything in human life, especially genuine happiness.
examples.zh: 金錢無法買到人生中的所有事物，特別是真正的快樂。

examples.en: Take a deep breath; everything will turn out fine in the end.
examples.zh: 深吸一口氣，最後一切都會好起來的。

examples.en: Don't worry; there is nothing wrong with your computer.
examples.zh: 別擔心，你的電腦完全沒有任何問題。

examples.en: He claimed that nothing could change his determination to succeed.
examples.zh: 他聲稱沒有任何事物能動搖他成功的決心。

examples.en: There is nothing better than enjoying an icy treat on a blazing summer day.
examples.zh: 在酷熱炎夏沒有什麼比來上一份冰品更過癮的了。

examples.en: I cannot find my house keys anywhere.
examples.zh: 我在任何地方都找不到我的家門鑰匙。

examples.en: With reliable internet, digital nomads can work from anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 有了穩定的網路，數位遊民可以在世界任何角落工作。

examples.en: You can park your shared bicycle anywhere inside the designated green zones.
examples.zh: 你可以將共享單車停放在指定綠色區域內的任何地點。

examples.en: Let's find somewhere quiet to study English together.
examples.zh: 我們找個安靜的地方一起讀英文吧。

examples.en: I know I left my glasses somewhere on this messy desk.
examples.zh: 我知道我把眼鏡忘在這張凌亂書桌的某個地方了。

examples.en: Somewhere deep in the mountains, a pristine hot spring waterfall flows.
examples.zh: 在深山某處，流淌著一座純淨天然的溫泉瀑布。

examples.en: Convenience stores are found everywhere in Taiwanese cities.
examples.zh: 在台灣各大城市，便利商店隨處可見。

examples.en: Colorful blooming azaleas blossom everywhere on the university campus in spring.
examples.zh: 春天時校園處處盛開著五彩斑斕的杜鵑花。

examples.en: Mobile technology connects people everywhere, bridging oceans and continents.
examples.zh: 行動科技將各地的民眾連結在一起，跨越了重洋與大陸。

examples.en: There was nowhere to park near the bustling night market.
examples.zh: 在熱鬧的夜市附近根本無處可以停車。

examples.en: During the fierce typhoon, there was nowhere safe outdoors.
examples.zh: 在強烈颱風肆虐期間，戶外根本沒有任何一處是安全的。

examples.en: The mysterious stray cat seemed to vanish into nowhere within seconds.
examples.zh: 那隻神秘的流浪貓彷彿在幾秒鐘內憑空消失得無影無蹤。

examples.en: I cooked a bowl of beef noodle soup for myself.
examples.zh: 我為自己煮了一碗牛肉麵。

examples.en: I promised myself to read at least one chapter every evening.
examples.zh: 我向自己保證每晚至少要讀完一個章節。

examples.en: I built this wooden bookshelf all by myself over the weekend.
examples.zh: 我利用週末完全靠自己親手打造了這個木製書架。

examples.en: Help yourself to some fresh fruits and hot tea.
examples.zh: 請自便享用一些新鮮水果和熱茶。

examples.en: Always believe in yourself and your unique capabilities.
examples.zh: 請始終相信你自己以及你獨一無二的才能。

examples.en: Did you hurt yourself when you fell off the skateboard?
examples.zh: 你從滑板上摔下來時有傷到自己嗎？

examples.en: He learned computer programming all by himself.
examples.zh: 他完全靠自學學會了電腦程式設計。

examples.en: He looked at himself in the mirror and adjusted his necktie.
examples.zh: 他看著鏡子裡的自己並整理好領帶。

examples.en: The grandfather built a charming wooden birdhouse for his garden himself.
examples.zh: 爺爺親手為他的花園建造了一座精巧迷人的木製鳥屋。

examples.en: She made a beautiful beaded bracelet for herself.
examples.zh: 她為自己做了一條漂亮的串珠手鍊。

examples.en: She taught herself how to play acoustic guitar through online video tutorials.
examples.zh: 她透過線上影片教學自學學會了彈奏木吉他。

examples.en: She took great pride in herself after passing the advanced certification exam.
examples.zh: 在通過高階檢定考試後，她為自己感到無比驕傲與自豪。

examples.en: The smart robot vacuum cleaner charges itself automatically.
examples.zh: 這台智慧掃地機器人會自動幫自己充電。

examples.en: History often repeats itself if societies fail to learn from past errors.
examples.zh: 如果社會未能從昔日錯誤中吸取教訓，歷史往往會重蹈覆轍。

examples.en: The majestic antique mansion is an architectural masterpiece in itself.
examples.zh: 這座宏偉的古典宅邸本身就是一座令人讚嘆的建築傑作。

examples.en: We prepared all the party decorations ourselves.
examples.zh: 我們自己動手準備了所有派對布置。

examples.en: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at the beach music festival last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們上週六在海灘音樂節上玩得非常盡興開心。

examples.en: We must rely on ourselves to solve complex mathematical challenges.
examples.zh: 我們必須依靠自己的力量來解開複雜的數學難題。

examples.en: Make yourselves comfortable, dear guests.
examples.zh: 親愛的客人們，請各位隨意放輕鬆。

examples.en: Did you all enjoy yourselves at the amusement park today?
examples.zh: 你們大家今天在主題遊樂園玩得盡興開懷嗎？

examples.en: Please introduce yourselves briefly before we start the collaborative workshop.
examples.zh: 在我們展開合作工作坊之前，請大家簡短自我介紹。

examples.en: The students cleaned the classroom by themselves.
examples.zh: 學生們自己把教室打掃乾淨了。

examples.en: Wild animals in national parks find food and shelter for themselves.
examples.zh: 國家公園裡的野生動物自行覓食並尋找棲息遮蔽之處。

examples.en: The runners pushed themselves to their physical limits during the final sprint.
examples.zh: 跑者們在最後衝刺階段竭盡全力挑戰自己的體能極限。

examples.en: Each student received a souvenir stationery set.
examples.zh: 每一位學生都收到了一份紀念文具組。

examples.en: The teammates encourage each other whenever training gets tough.
examples.zh: 每當訓練變得艱苦時，隊友們總是彼此互相打氣勉勵。

examples.en: Each of the hotel rooms features a scenic balcony overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 飯店的每一間客房都設有俯瞰大海的景觀陽台。

examples.en: We practice English conversation every single day.
examples.zh: 我們每一天都練習英語會話。

examples.en: The bullet train departs on time every fifteen minutes during rush hours.
examples.zh: 高鐵列車在尖峰時段每隔十五分鐘便準點發車一班。

examples.en: Every vote in a democracy plays a meaningful part in shaping society.
examples.zh: 在民主體制中，每一張選票在塑造社會未來時都發揮著重要作用。

examples.en: Are there any other questions about the grammar topic?
examples.zh: 關於這個文法主題還有其他任何問題嗎？

examples.en: We should listen respectfully to the opinions of other classmates.
examples.zh: 我們應該尊重並傾聽其他同學所表達的意見。

examples.en: On the other hand, online learning provides unparalleled schedule flexibility.
examples.zh: 另一方面，線上學習提供了無可比擬的時間彈性。

examples.en: Would you like another cup of hot soy milk?
examples.zh: 你想要再來一杯熱豆漿嗎？

examples.en: The team faced another difficult challenge after winning the semi-finals.
examples.zh: 在贏得準決賽後，該團隊面臨了另一項艱鉅考驗。

examples.en: If this shirt doesn't fit, I can fetch another one from the stockroom.
examples.zh: 如果這件襯衫不合身，我可以從庫房再拿另一件過來。

examples.en: Both of my parents are hardworking teachers.
examples.zh: 我的父母兩位都是辛勤敬業的老師。

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for both modern semiconductor technology and rich traditional culture.
examples.zh: 台灣以頂尖的現代半導體科技以及深厚的傳統文化兼美著稱。

examples.en: Both candidates presented compelling policy proposals during the televised debate.
examples.zh: 兩位候選人在電視辯論會中皆提出了引人注目的政策建言。

examples.en: You can take either the red line or the blue line MRT.
examples.zh: 你可以搭紅線捷運或藍線捷運。

examples.en: Either coffee or black tea is fine with me for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐喝咖啡或紅茶對我來說都可以。

examples.en: I haven't watched that new historical documentary either.
examples.zh: 我也還沒有看過那部新的歷史紀錄片。

examples.en: Neither option is suitable for our travel budget.
examples.zh: 這兩個選項都不符合我們的旅遊預算。

examples.en: Neither my brother nor my sister enjoys spicy Sichuan hot pot.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我姊姊都不喜歡吃辛辣的四川麻辣火鍋。

examples.en: He claims neither praise nor reward for his charitable deeds.
examples.zh: 他對自己所做的慈善善舉既不邀功也不索取回報。

examples.en: None of the stores were open on New Year's Day.
examples.zh: 元旦當天沒有任何一家商店開門營業。

examples.en: None of the five flight passengers suffered injuries during the emergency landing.
examples.zh: 在緊急迫降過程中，五名機上乘客無一人受傷。

examples.en: The teacher asked the difficult riddle, but none of us knew the answer.
examples.zh: 老師出了這道困難的謎題，但我們全班沒有人知道答案。

examples.en: Most Taiwanese students learn English at school.
examples.zh: 大多數台灣學生在學校學習英語。

examples.en: Pearl milk tea is the most popular beverage export from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶是台灣最受歡迎且聞名遐邇的出口飲品。

examples.en: Most of the old town's historical brick architecture remains well preserved.
examples.zh: 老鎮上大多數的歷史紅磚建築至今依舊保存得相當完善。

examples.en: We are almost at the top of the mountain trail!
examples.zh: 我們就快要走到登山步道頂端了！

examples.en: I have almost finished reading this five-hundred-page fantasy novel.
examples.zh: 我幾乎快要把這本長達五百頁的奇幻小說讀完了。

examples.en: The auditorium was almost full by the time the keynote speech started.
examples.zh: 在專題主題演講開始之時，大禮堂幾乎已經座無虛席。

examples.en: The weather in Hualien is quite pleasant today.
examples.zh: 花蓮今天的天氣相當宜人舒適。

examples.en: That math problem was quite difficult, but she solved it independently.
examples.zh: 那道數學題目相當困難，但她獨自一人解開了它。

examples.en: There were quite a few enthusiastic international tourists visiting the museum.
examples.zh: 有相當多熱情的外國觀光客前來參觀這座博物館。

examples.en: This English reading passage is pretty easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這篇英語閱讀文章相當容易理解。

examples.en: The coastal village looked pretty under the golden glow of twilight.
examples.zh: 在金色暮光的映照下，這座濱海漁村顯得格外秀麗迷人。

examples.en: I am doing pretty well on my university coursework this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期在大學課業上的表現相當不錯。

examples.en: Make sure you drink enough water during sports activities.
examples.zh: 運動期間務必確保喝足夠的水。

examples.en: We arrived at the station early enough to catch the first express train.
examples.zh: 我們抵達車站的時間足夠充裕，剛好趕上了首班自強號列車。

examples.en: That is more than enough food to feed all ten party guests generously.
examples.zh: 那些食物非常豐盛充裕，足夠款待所有十位派對賓客。

examples.en: There are lots of delicious food stands at the night market.
examples.zh: 夜市裡有許許多多美味的小吃攤位。

examples.en: Children had lots of fun splashing around in the public fountain pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公共噴泉戲水池裡玩得不亦樂乎。

examples.en: Planting lots of green trees in urban districts purifies city air effectively.
examples.zh: 在都會區廣植綠樹能非常有效地淨化城市空氣。

examples.en: There is only one piece of chocolate cake left.
examples.zh: 只剩下最後一塊巧克力蛋糕了。

examples.en: He is the only student in our class who speaks four fluent languages.
examples.zh: 他是我們班上唯一一位能流利說四種語言的學生。

examples.en: Not only did she complete the marathon, but she also beat her personal best.
examples.zh: 她不僅跑完了馬拉松全程，甚至還打破了自己的個人最佳紀錄。

examples.en: The train just arrived at platform two on time.
examples.zh: 火車剛好準時抵達第二月台。

examples.en: Just a moment, please; I will check your reservation in the system.
examples.zh: 請稍等片刻，我馬上在系統中為您確認訂房紀錄。

examples.en: A fair and just judge treats all citizens with equal dignity before the law.
examples.zh: 一位公正廉明的法官在法律面前以同等的尊嚴對待所有公民。

examples.en: A magnificent rainbow appeared after the afternoon rain shower.
examples.zh: 午後陣雨過後天空中出現了一道壯麗彩虹。

examples.en: Look at the vibrant double rainbow arching over the misty valley!
examples.zh: 快看那道跨越雲霧繚繞山谷的絢麗雙彩虹！

examples.en: Children love drawing bright rainbows with seven colored wax crayons.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡用七彩蠟筆在畫紙上畫出燦爛美麗的彩虹。

examples.en: Brilliant flashes of lightning lit up the stormy night sky.
examples.zh: 閃耀的閃電照亮了暴風雨的夜空。

examples.en: Never take shelter under an isolated tall tree during a lightning storm.
examples.zh: 雷雨交加時切莫在孤零零的高大路樹下避雨。

examples.en: A sudden flash of lightning was immediately followed by deafening thunder.
examples.zh: 一道突如其來的刺眼閃電隨即伴隨著震耳欲聾的滾滾雷鳴。

examples.en: The loud clap of thunder startled the resting puppy.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲把正在休息的小狗嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Distant thunder warned hikers that a summer storm was approaching fast.
examples.zh: 遠處隆隆的雷聲警示著登山者一場夏季暴風雨正迅速逼近。

examples.en: The heavy machinery produced a roar like continuous rolling thunder.
examples.zh: 重型機械設備發出如連綿滾滾雷鳴般的轟隆巨響。

examples.en: A severe thunderstorm caused heavy flooding in low areas.
examples.zh: 強烈雷陣雨導致低窪地區嚴重積水。

examples.en: Fishermen moored their fishing boats safely in the harbor before the storm.
examples.zh: 漁民們在暴風雨來臨前將漁船安全繫泊在港灣之中。

examples.en: The innovative startup took the global smartphone market by storm.
examples.zh: 這家創新型新創企業在全球智慧型手機市場掀起了一股強大風潮。

examples.en: The typhoon brought strong gusts and heavy downpours.
examples.zh: 颱風帶來了強勁陣風與豪雨。

examples.en: Local governments announce school closures on official typhoon days.
examples.zh: 地方政府會在正式宣布放颱風假時公布停班停課資訊。

examples.en: Residents boarded up windows to prevent damage during the fierce typhoon season.
examples.zh: 在強烈颱風盛行季節，居民們封好窗戶以防遭受損壞。

examples.en: We practice earthquake drills at school every semester.
examples.zh: 我們每學期都在學校進行地震防災演練。

examples.en: Modern architectural engineering incorporates shock absorbers against strong earthquakes.
examples.zh: 現代建築工程融入了能抵禦強烈地震的減震與隔震系統。

examples.en: Drop, cover, and hold on are the essential safety rules during an earthquake.
examples.zh: 「趴下、掩護、穩住」是遭遇地震時至關重要的避難原則。

examples.en: The banyan tree casts a wide, cool shadow on the lawn.
examples.zh: 榕樹在草坪上投下了大片涼爽的樹蔭。

examples.en: Shadows grow longer as the afternoon sun begins to descend.
examples.zh: 隨著午後夕陽開始西沉，地上的影子逐漸拉得越來越長。

examples.en: The clever detective followed the suspicious suspect like a silent shadow.
examples.zh: 那名機敏的警探猶如無聲的影子般悄悄尾隨可疑嫌犯。

examples.en: The stars shine brightly in the deep darkness of night.
examples.zh: 星星在漆黑的深夜中明亮地閃爍。

examples.en: He turned on his flashlight to navigate through the total darkness of the cavern.
examples.zh: 他打開手電筒在洞穴伸手不見五指的完全黑暗中引路前行。

examples.en: Morning dawn slowly banished the cold darkness of the winter night.
examples.zh: 晨曦破曉逐漸驅散了寒冷冬夜的漆黑與寂寥。

examples.en: Sunshine is bright and warm on a sunny spring morning.
examples.zh: 春天陽光普照的早晨，陽光明媚又溫暖。

examples.en: She has a bright mind and constantly invents creative solutions to puzzles.
examples.zh: 她思維敏捷聰穎，總是能針對難題提出極富創意的解方。

examples.en: Diligent study today lays the foundation for a bright and successful future.
examples.zh: 今日勤奮用功的研讀為光明燦爛且成功的未來奠定基石。

examples.en: It gets dark early in winter evenings.
examples.zh: 冬天的傍晚天黑得特別早。

examples.en: She wore a sophisticated dark navy blue suit to the corporate conference.
examples.zh: 她穿著一套典雅穩重的深深藍色套裝出席企業高峰論壇。

examples.en: Citizens were kept in the dark regarding the secret municipal construction plans.
examples.zh: 市民對於這項機密市政建設計畫起初完全被蒙在鼓裡。

examples.en: The cat has remarkably soft and fluffy fur.
examples.zh: 這隻貓咪擁有極為柔軟蓬鬆的毛皮。

examples.en: Gentle, soft classical music played in the background as diners conversed.
examples.zh: 輕柔舒緩的古典音樂在背景流淌，顧客們在悠揚琴聲中交談。

examples.en: Convenient store shelves offer a wide variety of refreshing soft drinks.
examples.zh: 便利商店貨架上陳列著琳瑯滿目且清涼解渴的無酒精清涼飲料。

examples.en: Diamond is the hardest natural mineral known.
examples.zh: 鑽石是已知最堅硬的天然礦物。

examples.en: Work hard today so you can harvest rewarding results tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今日辛勤耕耘努力付出，明日方能收穫豐碩甜美的回報。

examples.en: The challenging university physics examination was exceptionally hard to pass.
examples.zh: 那場具挑戰性的大學物理測驗極難通過。

examples.en: Heavy traffic delayed our arrival at the station.
examples.zh: 壅塞繁重的車流耽誤了我們抵達車站的時間。

examples.en: Heavy rains during monsoon season replenished the island's water reservoirs.
examples.zh: 梅雨季節豐沛的豪雨及時蓄滿了這座島嶼各大水庫的蓄水量。

examples.en: The student carried a heavy backpack filled with science textbooks and supplies.
examples.zh: 這名學生背著一個裝滿了理科教科書與用具的沉重書包。

examples.en: Aluminum is a durable and very light metal.
examples.zh: 鋁是一種耐用且非常輕盈的金屬。

examples.en: Sunlight streamed through the bedroom window, illuminating the wooden desk.
examples.zh: 陽光透過臥室窗戶灑落進來，照亮了質樸的木製書桌。

examples.en: Pack light when traveling so you can walk comfortably between city transit lines.
examples.zh: 旅行時請輕裝簡行，這樣在城市各交通轉運路線之間移動才會輕鬆自如。
